items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: There's Matthew Gee. He's continuing to play there.

ctx.x: Who are some of the other jazz musicians that he has at his church?

Well, he has one fellow there that's named Lewis, you know. He's a great pianist, you know. Stanley Turrentine used to play there. There's Matthew Gee. He's continuing to play there. Well, he just had some fellow named John. And John -- I can't think -- I can't remember his last name. But he also plays the piano. He plays several instruments.
Didn't he preside over the Baby Lawrence funeral?
